test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 20 Jan 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Solve the following.

(sqrt3 - sqrt2) × (sqrt3 + sqrt2) = ?
solution:
Concept used:

A² - B² = (A + B) (A - B)

Calculation:

(sqrt3 - sqrt2) × (sqrt3 + sqrt2)

⇒ {(sqrt3)² - (sqrt2)²}

⇒ 3 - 2

⇒ 1

∴ The simplified value is 1.
